box.highlights: Connetquot 42, Newfield 6: Vincent Feraca completed 14 of 16 passes for 265 yards and four touchdowns to lead host Connetquot in a Suffolk II opener. Nick Mastriano caught six passes for 93 yards and two touchdowns, Jonas Mendez caught a 40-yard touchdown pass and Kingston Maugeri added a 13-yard touchdown catch. Javon Barnwell ran for 158 yards and two touchdowns on 21 carries. Danny Ryan had 10 tackles and Sonny Kowalevich had three tackles-for-loss. Nicholas Leoni caught a 77-yard touchdown pass from Connor Stebbins for Newfield.

Northport 21, Connetquot 13: Greyson Cabrera had a 35-yard rushing touchdown and a 38-yard receiving score to lead host Northport (3-0) in Suffolk II. Cabrera had 135 yards of offense and made 16 tackles. Ryder Maag took a screen pass 71 yards for a score in the third quarter. Carson Ciaio batted down the final pass as time expired as Northport stopped Connetquot four times from inside the 10-yard line in the final minute. Vincent Feraca had a rushing touchdown for Connetquot (1-2).

Half Hollow Hills East 40, Connetquot 19: Jayden Bryan rushed for 100 yards and 4 TDs and added 5 tackles to lead traveling Half Hollow Hills East (2-2) in Suffolk II. Daniel White rushed for 160 yards and 1 TD.  Akio Johnson had 8 tackles and 1 sack, Dante Milano had 7 tackles, and Alex Floropolus had 4 tackles and 1 sack. Damian Sosa had a 75-yard fumble return for Connetquot (1-3).

Huntington 21, Connetquot 14: Jacob Guzik went 12 for 15 in passing with 131 yards and a TD to lead Huntington (4-1) in Suffolk II. Yasir Jones had 84 yards and a touchdown on 15 carries while Titan Elysee recorded an 85-yard kick return touchdown. Vincent Feraca went 11 for 17 with 117 yards and a touchdown for Connetquot (1-4). Jonas Mendez added 60 yards and a touchdown on two receptions.

Connetquot 42, Centereach 14: Javon Barnwell had 20 carries for 142 yards and two touchdowns to lead host Connetquot (2-4) in Suffolk II. Vincent Feraca completed 9 of 10 passes for 147 yards and two TDs to Jonas Mendez, who caught four passes for 68 yards. Marcus Anglin ran for 80 yards and a TD. Angelo Prestigiacomo had a 40-yard pick-6. Danny Ryan had 15 tackles and a sack and Sonny Kowalevich had 10 tackles, including two for loss, and two sacks. Jason Cesa ran for a touchdown and threw a 73-yard TD pass to Nasir Jean Louis for Centereach (1-5).

East Islip 28, Connetquot 7: Niko Meyers had nine carries for 173 yards and two touchdowns and Jake Simmons ran 23 times for 151 yards and two TDs to lead host East Islip (6-1) in Suffolk II. Evan Gordon and Jovan Bonilla each had a sack. Nick Mastriano caught an 11-yard TD pass from Vincent Feraca for Connetquot (2-5).

Connetquot 35, West Babylon 0: Javon Barnwell had 10 carries for 131 yards and two touchdowns, including a 90-yard score to lead visiting Connetquot (3-5) in Suffolk II. Dominic Cowans recovered a blocked punt in the end zone for a TD. Caleb Maugeri had a 47-yard TD run and Jonas Mendez ran for a 3-yard score. Mendez also added 93 yards on three punt returns. West Babylon is 1-7.

East Islip 38, Connetquot 0: Jake Simmons had 25 carries for 188 yards and four touchdowns to lead host No. 1 East Islip over No. 8 Connetquot in the Suffolk II quarterfinals. Mikey Tramaglini had an interception and Dylan Bayer recovered a fumble forced by Andrew Arena. AJ Ierardi added a 2-yard TD run and Chris Coreas made a 30-yard field goal and all five of his PATs. East Islip (8-1) will host a semifinal at 4 p.m. on Friday. Connetquot finished 3-6.
